title: Tally v1.4 product value experiment task-set manifest
description: Schema for the frozen task set consumed by P4-02/P4-03. A manifest is valid only if every task carries pinned fixtures and freeze identity; any byte change after freeze invalidates the trial unless both arms re-run (PRE_REGISTRATION §5).

frozen_at.description: Timestamp when the task set was frozen (before arm A execution).

trial_ref.description: Git commit or tag hash the manifest was frozen at.

environment_parity.description: Identity that must be identical across arms (PRE_REGISTRATION §6).

model.description: Model id used by both arms.

tasks.description: Frozen task set. No additions/removals after freeze.

inclusion_rationale.description: Why this task is in the set; assigned at freeze, immutable.

fixture_hashes.description: path → sha256 of every fixture the task depends on.

acceptance_frozen.description: Hash of the frozen Contract acceptance used by BOTH arms.

intent_text_sha256.description: Hash of the verbatim intent text given to both arms.

excluded.description: May only be set true with a PRE_REGISTRATION §5 exclusion reason, recorded in exclusion_reason, applying to BOTH arms.
